payload.rationale: Without a specific weather forecast for Miami on September 19, 2026, the estimate relies on climatological base rates. The average daily maximum temperature for Miami in mid-to-late September is typically around 89°F. Because Miami's late-summer/early-fall temperatures are highly consistent, a narrow 2-degree band (88°F to 89°F) positioned right at the climatological mean captures a substantial portion of the probability mass. The strongest reason this estimate could be too high is if the actual forecast for that day calls for significant rain or a tropical system, which would suppress highs into the low 80s, or if it is an unusually hot and dry day pushing highs into the low 90s. The strongest reason it could be too low is that 88-89°F represents the most frequent daily high temperature for this time of year, meaning the true base rate could be closer to 40% in the absence of anomalous weather patterns.
limitations: No current weather forecast data available for the target date.
Uncertainty regarding the exact standard deviation of daily high temperatures in Miami during late September.
